description: 16x16 grayscale/8, distinct grey bands, 144 dpi resolution resource (ImageMagick writes it as 0x00900001, one LSB above exactly 144).

expectationSource.method: psd-tools PSDImage.open() for structure and layer records; composite() for compositePixels; layer.numpy() for layerPixels. No Agogo code in the loop.

writer.lossyReason: PLAN.md S.10.2: psdexport emits layer channels in its own fixed order (0,1,2,-1; gray 0,-1) and always emits an alpha channel, because the engine model is RGBA. This fixture was authored with alpha first (-1,0,1,2) or with no alpha channel at all, so every re-exported record's channelIds differ in order and the flattened records gain a -1. The PSD spec does not prescribe channel order and readers key on the ID, so this is a spelling difference rather than lost data: the set of IDs is otherwise unchanged, the -2 user mask channel included. psd-tools 1.19.0 and ImageMagick 6.9.12-98 both read the re-export correctly.

externalVerification.notes: tools/psdfixtures/verify_dump.py --identify re-read the Agogo re-export with psd-tools 1.19.0 and ImageMagick 6.9.12-98; both accepted the file and reported the expected structure. See testdata/VERIFICATION.md.
